def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def load(p): return json.loads(p.read_bytes())
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO), *args])
def norm(b): return b.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n')
def variants(b):
    b = norm(b)
    return [b, b.replace(b'\n', b'\r\n')]

def reverse_diff(after, diff):
    """Reconstruct a before snapshot from a recorded unified diff."""
    src = norm(after).decode('utf-8').splitlines()
    before, pos, i = [], 0, 2
    while i < len(diff):
        header = re.fullmatch(r'@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@.*', diff[i])
        assert header, diff[i]
        old_start, old_count, new_start, new_count = header.groups()
        target = int(new_start) - 1
        assert target >= pos
        before.extend(src[pos:target]); pos = target
        old_n = new_n = 0
        assert len(before) == int(old_start) - 1
        i += 1
        while i < len(diff) and not diff[i].startswith('@@ '):
            row = diff[i]; tag, text = row[:1], row[1:]
            assert tag in {' ', '-', '+'}, row
            if tag in {' ', '+'}:
                assert src[pos] == text
                pos += 1; new_n += 1
            if tag in {' ', '-'}:
                before.append(text); old_n += 1
            i += 1
        assert old_n == int(old_count or 1) and new_n == int(new_count or 1)
    before.extend(src[pos:])
    return ('\n'.join(before) + '\n').encode('utf-8')

inputs = {}
for cid, e in selected.items():

        b = (SPEC/e[kind]['path']).read_bytes()
        assert sha(b) == e[kind]['sha256'] and len(b) == e[kind]['bytes']
    inputs[cid] = load(SPEC/e['input']['path'])

roles, context_records = [], []
for role, expected in EXPECTED.items():
    for filename, digest in expected.items():
        assert sha((ROOT/role/filename).read_bytes()) == digest
    v = load(ROOT/role/'vote.json'); s = load(ROOT/role/'sources.json')
    assert v['role'] == role and v['scopeStatus'] == 'COMPLETE' and v['vote'] == 'JA'
    assert v['wholeDocument'] is True and v['unconditional'] is True
    assert v['proposedTextChanges'] == [] and v.get('additionalConditions', []) == []
    assert v['ballotSha256Before'] == v['ballotSha256After'] == BALLOT
    assert v['reportSha256'] == expected['report.md']
    assert Path(v['reportPath']) == ROOT/role/'report.md'
    assert v['implementationAuthorized'] is False and v['ratificationIssued'] is False
    assert v['wholeManifestVerdict'] == 'NOT_ISSUED'
    sections = {x['section'] for x in v['sectionAssessments']}
    assert {'A1','A2','A3','A4','A5'} <= sections
    assert v['findings'] and any('T05' in x['finding'] for x in v['findings'])
    if role == 'didaktik':
        immutable = s['immutable']; mutable = s['mutableContext']
        assert v['sourceBindings']['immutable'] == immutable
        assert s['otherCurrentRoleVotesRead'] is False
        assert s['checks']['immutableCount'] == len(immutable) == 37
        assert {x['id'] for x in s['selectedCaseBindings']} == CASES
        for entry in s['selectedCaseBindings']:
            assert entry['input'] == selected[entry['id']]['input']
            assert entry['oracle'] == selected[entry['id']]['oracle']
            assert sha((SPEC/entry['scene']['path']).read_bytes()) == entry['scene']['sha256']
        assert v['sourceBindings']['mutableContext'] == [{k: x[k] for k in y if k in x} | {k: y[k] for k in ['exactDiffPath','exactDiffPointer']} for x,y in zip(mutable,v['sourceBindings']['mutableContext'])]
    else:
        a = s['verification']; immutable = a['immutableSources']; mutable = a['mutableContexts']
        assert v['sourceBindings']['immutableSources'] == immutable
        assert v['sourceBindings']['mutableContexts'] == mutable
        assert v['sourceBindings']['detailsSha256'] == expected['sources.json']
        assert v['sourceBindings']['immutableSourceCount'] == len(immutable) == 41
        assert set(a['scopeCaseIds']) == CASES
        rec = a['mutableContextReconciliation']; diff = rec['exactDiffBinding']
        assert rec['newRoleVotesRead'] is False
        assert diff['beforeCommit'] == BEFORE and diff['afterCommit'] == HEAD
        assert sha(diff['gitDiffUtf8'].encode('utf-8')) == diff['gitDiffSha256']
        actual_diff = git('diff', BEFORE, HEAD, '--', *diff['paths'])
        assert norm(actual_diff) == norm(diff['gitDiffUtf8'].encode('utf-8'))
        for b in diff['blobs']:
            rel = Path(b['path']).relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
            assert sha(git('show', BEFORE+':'+rel)) == b['beforeCommitBlobSha256']
            assert sha(git('show', HEAD+':'+rel)) == b['afterCommitBlobSha256']
            assert sha(b['worktreeDiffUtf8'].encode('utf-8')) == b['worktreeDiffSha256']
        for u in a['referenceChecks']['undoReferences']:
            byseq = {e['seq']:e for e in inputs[u['caseId']]['events']}
            undo, move = byseq[u['undoSeq']], byseq[u['moveSeq']]
            assert undo['type'] == 'action.undone' and move['type'] == 'material.moved'
            assert undo['eventId'] == u['undoEventId'] and move['eventId'] == u['moveEventId']
            assert undo['payload']['moveId'] == move['payload']['moveId'] == u['moveId']
            assert undo['actor'] == move['actor'] == u['actor']
            assert move['payload']['items'] == u['items']
    assert len({x['path'] for x in immutable}) == len(immutable)
    for x in immutable:
        b = Path(x['path']).read_bytes()
        assert sha(b) == x['sha256Before'] == x['sha256After'], x['path']
        assert x['unchanged'] is True
        assert len(b) == x.get('bytes', x.get('sizeBytesAfter'))
    assert {x['path'] for x in mutable} == CONTEXTS
    for x in mutable:
        p = Path(x['path']); after = p.read_bytes(); rel = p.relative_to(REPO).as_posix()
        assert sha(after) == x['sha256After']
        assert norm(after) == norm(git('show', HEAD+':'+rel))
        if role == 'didaktik':
            before = reverse_diff(after, x['diff'])
            assert x['sha256Before'] in {sha(b) for b in variants(before)}
            comparison = 'exact_recorded_diff_reconstructed; permitted intermediate parent snapshot'
        else:
            before = git('show', BEFORE+':'+rel)
            assert x['sha256Before'] in {sha(b) for b in variants(before)}
            comparison = 'parent_commit_blob_with_explicit_LF_CRLF_distinction'
        context_records.append({'role':role, 'path':x['path'], 'sha256Before':x['sha256Before'], 'sha256After':x['sha256After'], 'verification':comparison})
    roles.append({'role':role,'scopeStatus':v['scopeStatus'],'vote':v['vote'],'wholeDocument':True,'unconditional':True,'ballotSha256':BALLOT,'immutableSourcesVerified':len(immutable),'files':expected})
